Digital & Online Color Run Games
Color Rush (Autorunner): A fast-paced online parkour game where you guide a character forward, jump, and switch your character's color to match the ground. Mismatched colors end the run immediately. You can play it on platforms like Color Rush. 
Color Run on Roblox: A multiplayer survival/territory game where you run around to leave light-colored footprints, try to loop back to your deep color base, and avoid getting surrounded by other players. You can check it out on Roblox Color Run. 
Color Run - Color Jump / Cube Jump: Casual mobile arcade games where you guide a ball or cube through obstacles and spinning color-swap bars, matching the correct color patterns to pass through.

Color Pencil Run: A skill game where you control a growing pencil and match its color with tracks to increase its size, available on Poki. 
Real-World Physical Game
The Color Run: A global 5-kilometer (3.1-mile) paint race inspired by the Hindu festival of Holi. It is an untimed event where participants are showered with food-grade corn starch colored powder at different stations. 
Wikipedia
Rainbow Run (Kids Game): A physical movement game for young children where kids jump through a sequence of colored hula hoops called out by a leader ("Simon").
